recommendations.headline: Call satisfaction, not price, is the biggest predictor of winning a sale (71% win-rate when customer is satisfied vs 15% when neutral and only 5% when dissatisfied), yet 60% of calls end neutral/dissatisfied and common rep gaps (unclear answers in 408 calls, no fixed follow-up in 396, no quote sent in 230) are leaving business on the table.
behaviour: Price enquiry is the top intent (852/2492, 34%) and price_shopper is the top behaviour tag (434), but in 70% of calls (1,749) price is never even discussed - most calls stall before pricing.
Callback is the most common outcome (1,149, 46%) far outweighing actual orders (486, 20%), showing customers routinely defer decisions rather than reject them (not_interested is only 111).
Stock_availability is tied with price as the top objection (339 vs 340) and is the single highest customer need (458, just above fast_delivery 461) - availability concerns rival price concerns.

Dealers dominate call volume (1,192, 48%) and convert best among known segments (40% win), but 914 calls (37%) have an unidentified segment and convert at only 25% - we are not qualifying a third of callers.
Repeat (220) and bulk buyers (224) are common, yet only 19 calls are tagged loyal_to_us - high repeat volume is not translating into recognised loyalty.
satisfaction: Only 35% of calls (882) end satisfied, 52% (1,287) are neutral and 8.5% (212) are dissatisfied - the bulk of calls sit in a flat, unconvincing middle.
Satisfaction strongly predicts sales: win rate is 71% when satisfied vs 15% neutral and just 5% dissatisfied - fixing call experience has far more leverage than price moves.

Price itself is survivable: calls with a price_high objection still close at 28% (above the 20% overall order rate), and only 77 calls explicitly said price was too high - the real issue is how the call is handled, flagged by slow/unclear answers in 408 calls and no follow-up fixed in 396.

Stock and delivery objections convert worse than price objections (25% win for stock_availability, 25% for delivery_time, 21% for transport_cost vs 28% for price_high), suggesting logistics confidence is a bigger satisfaction gap than cost.

conversion.title: Make every call end with a satisfied customer, not neutral
conversion.evidence: Win rate is 71% satisfied vs 15% neutral vs 5% dissatisfied; 52% of calls are currently neutral.
conversion.action: Train reps to confirm understanding, repeat back requirements, and explicitly ask 'does this answer your question?' before ending any call.

conversion.title: Eliminate slow/unclear answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer flagged in 408 calls, the single most common rep gap.
conversion.action: Give reps a quick-reference spec/price sheet and stock dashboard so answers on size, GSM, color and rate are instant and precise.

conversion.title: Turn every callback into a scheduled next step
conversion.evidence: Callback is 46% of outcomes (1,149) and no_follow_up_fixed appears in 396 calls.
conversion.action: Mandate reps set a specific date/time for the next contact before hanging up and log it in CRM/calendar for manager tracking.

conversion.title: Send a written quote on every price enquiry
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent flagged in 230 calls against 852 price enquiries.
conversion.action: Make WhatsApp/email quotation sending a mandatory step immediately after quoting a rate verbally.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order
conversion.action: Add a closing script step: 'Shall I book this for you now?' after every quote or stock confirmation.

conversion.title: Proactively manage stock-availability conversations
conversion.evidence: stock_availability is tied-top objection (339) and top need (458) with only 25% win rate; didnt_offer_alternative flagged in 135 calls.
conversion.action: When an item is out of stock, reps must immediately offer the nearest in-stock alternative and give a restock ETA rather than ending the call.

conversion.title: Qualify unknown-segment callers
conversion.evidence: 914 calls (37%) have unclassified segment and convert at only 25% vs 40% for dealers.
conversion.action: Add a quick segment question (dealer/fabricator/contractor/end-user) early in the call to route pitch and pricing appropriately.

offers.title: On-call cutting/processing service
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and contractors needing site-ready sheets
offers.why: cutting_processing need appears 101 times and multiple well-converted calls involved cutting requests.

offers.title: Guaranteed same/next-day site delivery slots
offers.why: fast_delivery is the top need (461) and site_delivery is needed 104 times; several successful calls involved same-day or evening delivery commitments.

offers.title: Instant proforma invoice/quotation service
offers.why: Multiple well-converted calls explicitly requested a proforma invoice before confirming; no_quote_sent flagged in 230 calls shows this is often missed.

offers.title: Evaluate a short credit-period option for established dealers
offers.why: credit_period need (83), needs_credit behaviour (97) and credit_terms objection (73, 29% win) indicate unmet demand that converts reasonably well already.

offers.title: Fast-track sample dispatch with a fixed turnaround promise
offers.why: samples need appears 64 times and one call showed explicit frustration over delayed sample feedback.

offers.title: Consolidated bulk-order quoting with single-point coordination
offers.why: bulk_buyer tag appears 224 times and builder/industrial segments already show strong win rates (41%, 38%).

loyalty.title: Proactive rate/stock update alerts
loyalty.how: Send a periodic WhatsApp broadcast of current rates and stock availability to regular dealers/fabricators
loyalty.why: regular_updates is needed in 207 calls, the fourth-highest need overall.

loyalty.title: Formal repeat-customer recognition tier
loyalty.how: Flag repeat_buyer and bulk_buyer accounts in CRM and give them a named contact/priority handling
loyalty.why: Repeat_buyer (220) and bulk_buyer (224) behaviours are common but loyal_to_us is tagged only 19 times, showing a recognition gap.

loyalty.title: Dealer gifting/appreciation program
loyalty.how: Formalise and schedule the existing JSW-linked promotional gifts (noted in one successful call) around festivals
loyalty.why: Customers directly asked 'Will there be a Diwali gift this year?' twice in the question log, showing expectation already exists.

loyalty.title: Proactive documentation bundle
loyalty.how: Automatically attach test certificate and invoice copy via WhatsApp with every dispatch, without being asked
loyalty.why: Customers explicitly requested test certificates/invoices via WhatsApp multiple times; quality_assurance need (126) and test_certificate need (19) support this.

loyalty.title: After-sales check-in calls
loyalty.how: Schedule a short follow-up call after delivery to confirm satisfaction and handle any issues
loyalty.why: after_sales_support need is logged 43 times and could reduce the dissatisfied call pool (currently 212, only 5% win rate).

loyalty.title: Referral acknowledgement
loyalty.how: Track and thank customers who refer others with a small non-price gesture (priority service, early stock access)
loyalty.why: referral behaviour is tagged 27 times, showing organic word-of-mouth worth nurturing.

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor quality assurance
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt objection appears in 93 calls and test_certificate requests recur; leading with authorised-distributor status can pre-empt doubt.

non_price_benefits.title: Wide colour and product range including Color On Plus variants
non_price_benefits.why: Multiple calls (grey, off-white, sky blue, CG green) show colour range is a decision factor and Color On Plus is the 2nd most discussed product (272 mentions).

non_price_benefits.title: Strong technical/product guidance
non_price_benefits.why: technical_advice is the 3rd highest need (397) and needs_technical_help is the 2nd highest behaviour (356) - expertise is a real differentiator.

non_price_benefits.title: Proven fast dispatch capability
non_price_benefits.why: Numerous well-converted calls confirm same-day/evening delivery was successfully executed, reinforcing reliability as a selling point.

non_price_benefits.title: Customisation via cutting and flashing adjustments
non_price_benefits.why: Successful calls show flexible cutting, length changes, and flashing quantity adjustments handled smoothly - a convenience competitors may not offer.

top_questions.question: What is the rate for this sheet/screw/coil?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm exact spec and quantity first, then give the rate clearly and immediately follow up with a written quote.

top_questions.question: Is this size/colour/thickness in stock right now?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock before answering; if unavailable, immediately offer the closest in-stock alternative and a restock timeline.

top_questions.question: Can you deliver today/tomorrow morning?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific, realistic delivery window based on dispatch schedule and confirm it in writing so there's no ambiguity later.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce the price / match a competitor's rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Acknowledge the comparison, then highlight quality certification, reliable supply and service before escalating any price flexibility per policy.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation/proforma invoice?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send it during or immediately after the call via WhatsApp/email rather than promising to send it later.

top_questions.question: Can the test certificate/invoice be sent via WhatsApp instead of with the driver?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm yes and make digital document sharing the default for every dispatch going forward.

top_questions.question: Why did another customer get a different/cheaper price?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain that pricing depends on quantity, payment terms and segment, and reassure the policy is applied consistently.

top_questions.question: Will there be a loyalty bonus or festival gift this year?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm current scheme status if one exists, or note interest and pass to management for a formal loyalty gesture.
